name: Life State Custody
definition: Holding, organising and serving the body of data describing the user's life, so that every agent reads the same picture.
rationale: Agents hold private partial views and contradict one another.

name: Life Data Ingestion
definition: Acquiring data from external sources on a continuing basis, without the user carrying it between systems.
rationale: Data moved by hand is data that arrives late or not at all.

name: Agent Coordination
definition: Directing work to agents, permitting agents to obtain answers from one another, and resolving contention, within a declared hierarchy.
rationale: The suite has no coordinator, and authority must be scoped by position.

name: Work Management
definition: Holding work as tracked tasks and carrying them across sessions and interruptions.
rationale: Work must outlive the conversation that created it.

name: Condition Detection and Initiation
definition: Evaluating declared conditions against life state and opening contact with the user unprompted.
rationale: Proactivity is impossible without scheduled evaluation and an outbound channel.

name: Conversation and Reach
definition: Accepting and returning interaction by voice and by text, from whichever client the user is at.
rationale: Voice-led on phone, text-led on laptop, resumable across both.

name: Authorization
definition: Gating declared classes of action behind an explicit affirmative answer from the user.
rationale: Some actions are irreversible or reach other people.

name: External Actuation
definition: Effecting change outside the system: calendar, files, messages, third-party systems.
rationale: Agents that cannot act can only advise.

name: Provenance
definition: Recording how a belief was arrived at, and whether it was observed or inferred.
rationale: Inference presented as fact is indistinguishable from error.

name: Agent Lifecycle Governance
definition: Defining, creating, revising and retiring agent definitions under change control.
rationale: Agents are components; the population will grow.

name: Self-Observation
definition: Reporting the system's own cost, health and usage.
rationale: A ceiling discovered after the fact is not a ceiling.

name: Behavioural Learning
definition: Deriving patterns and preferences from observed data, beyond what is stated explicitly.
rationale: Stated preferences are a fraction of actual ones.
